title: Patronage Capital Retirement Terms by Patron Class — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital)
content:
# Retirement Terms by Patron Class

For Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), the general retirement terms below are the same in the Residential, Seasonal, Farm, General Service, Irrigation and Large Power Patron Classes.

| Term | Residential | Seasonal | Farm | General Service | Irrigation | Large Power |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| General retirement method | hybrid FIFO and percentage | hybrid FIFO and percentage | hybrid FIFO and percentage | hybrid FIFO and percentage | hybrid FIFO and percentage | hybrid FIFO and percentage |
| Month whose bills and check run carry the general retirement | December (12) | December (12) | December (12) | December (12) | December (12) | December (12) |
| Wholesale-supplier allocations retired only through the year the supplier has itself retired to Cedar Fork | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rounding of every retirement, discount and payable | to the cent, per allocation year and source | same | same | same | same | same |

**Terms explained.**

- *Hybrid FIFO and percentage* means that each board resolution retires all remaining credits of the oldest open allocation years and, in addition, a percentage of one recent allocation year.
- *Retired only when received* means that a wholesale-supplier (pass-through) allocation is retired no further than the allocation year the wholesale supplier has itself retired to Cedar Fork.
- *Per allocation year and source* means that each allocation year is rounded on its own, and within a year the distribution-margin allocation and the wholesale-supplier allocation are rounded separately; amounts are never totalled across years or sources before rounding.

**Example (hypothetical).** A resolution adopted in a given year is paid with that year's December bills and the December check run, in every patron class alike.
